meaning:
1) to make a nest
1a) (Piel) to make a nest
1b) (Pual) to be nested

elsewhere.note: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.
The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.
Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!
All the birds of the sky made their nests in its boughs. Under its branches, all the animals of the field gave birth to their young. All great nations lived…
